faqs.q: Do I need to be photogenic?
faqs.a: Not at all. Your photographer guides you and shoots natural moments. Most people forget the camera is there after ten minutes.

faqs.q: When do I receive my photos?
faqs.a: From 48 hours for a short session, up to 5 days for a full-day story. We tell you the exact date when you book.

faqs.q: Can I get the original files?
faqs.a: You receive all edited photos in full resolution. Unedited originals can be added on request.

faqs.q: What if the weather is bad?
faqs.a: We move your session to another time or day. Some of the best light comes just after the rain.

faqs.q: Can I print the photos anywhere?
faqs.a: Yes. You own the pictures for personal use and can print them anywhere, or order prints and books from us.
